programs.title: South America's Weirdest Animals
programs.desc: The creators of the program present the wildest parts of South America and the creatures inhabiting them that had to adapt to difficult conditions.These animals are peculiar and surprising.

programs.title: Dolphins Up Close with Bertie Gregory
programs.desc: British filmmaker Bertie Gregory brings nature's wonders to life with groundbreaking cinematography in some of Earth's most extreme environments.Recently, National Geographic viewers could, for example, observe the inhabitants of the frosty south in the film "The Secret Life of Penguins".The heroes of the latest documentary are mammals famous for their intelligence.Equipped with drones, cutting-edge cameras and underwater technologies, creators can capture their world from a previously unavailable perspective.A haven for marine mammals, the Azores are an archipelago of volcanic islands located in the central part of the Atlantic Ocean.They are considered one of the best places for observing whales and dolphins.Bertie Gregory reaches the coast of Portugal, where the hunting season is in progress.Thousands of predators hunt together for large schools of fish that form balls.The team, struggling with storms, tries to film this rare spectacle of nature.It also follows pods of dolphins that perform acrobatics by jumping out of the water.During his journey, Bertie also discovers the dark history of marine exploitation in the region.He has the opportunity to see the consequences of the whaling ban in the 1980s.

programs.title: America The Beautiful: Wild Frontier
programs.desc: A documentary series devoted to the American border and its nature.The program presents the legends of the Wild West, which are intertwined with stories about local animal species.
